why: No major reviewer or authority appears in these results. Most of them are templated affiliate listicles, a UGREEN-only roundup, one UGREEN product page, and a KVM page that answers a neighbouring question. PicksLab gives a direct pick, but it is a 5 Gbps model with no SSD testing. No source compares 10 Gbps USB-C switches on drive speed and price. A focused page that does this could stand out.
